items.title: createUsersStep
items.description:
This step creates one or more users. To allow these users to log in,
you must attach an auth identity to each user using the [setAuthAppMetadataStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/setAuthAppMetadataStep).

items.title: deleteUsersStep
items.description: This step deletes one or more users.

items.title: updateUsersStep
items.description: This step updates one or more users.
